title: Preserving the Ultrapower Axiom by Forcing over Nonoverlapping Extender Models
summary: We identify a class of simple yet nontrivial forcing notions that preserve the Ultrapower Axiom (UA) over canonical inner models, reaching the level of a strong cardinal. The forcings we consider are discrete product forcings whose index sets are chosen and spaced according to the structure of the underlying nonoverlapping extender sequence. As an application, we show that UA is consistent with the existence of a strong cardinal $κ$ such that $V\neq \text{HOD}_X$ for every $X\in V_κ$, answering a question of Goldberg.
